questions.question: After Israel lost its first battle to the Philistines, what plan did the elders of Israel come up with?

answers.text: Ask Samuel to pray for them

questions.question: When Israel took the ark of God into battle against the Philistines, what happened to the ark?

answers.text: It was destroyed in the battle

questions.question: Eli, who judged Israel, fell from his chair after hearing news from the battle. Which part of the news was he hearing?
When Eli's daughter-in-law named her newborn son Ichabod, what did she say?

answers.text: The glory has departed from Israel
The LORD has remembered His people
God has heard the cry of Israel
